evidenceSemantics.observedOutcome: A concrete check ran and emitted a pass or failure observation for one exact subject. A later failure does not erase an earlier observation.
evidenceSemantics.acceptedEvidence: A receipt was validated against its exact candidate, tree, deployment, and authority rules. Accepted stage evidence is monotone within an evidence bundle.
evidenceSemantics.overallAcceptance: The bundle is accepted only when every required stage, five distinct assurance principals, evidence-before-approval chronology, and the final production approval are accepted. A failed bundle may retain earlier accepted stage evidence without authorizing production or release.

designDefined.observationAuthority: tracked manifest and generated projections at the candidate tree
designDefined.acceptanceAuthority: exact candidate tree plus generated-artifact drift check
designDefined.passAuthority: tracked manifest and generated status projection

codePresent.observationAuthority: source roots observed in the exact candidate tree
codePresent.acceptanceAuthority: exact candidate tree and package-boundary qualification

sourceTestsPassed.observationAuthority: exact-SHA workflow outcomes for dependency, lint, unit, contract, build, Lane B, and documentation checks
sourceTestsPassed.acceptanceAuthority: validated hepta.ui-control.qualification-receipt.v2 bound to the exact source commit and tree

browserTestsPassed.observationAuthority: exact-SHA Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, keyboard, focus, and axe outcomes
browserTestsPassed.acceptanceAuthority: validated source-head qualification receipt with browserTestsPassed and exact build-manifest digest

mergeTreePassed.acceptanceAuthority: validated synthetic-merge qualification receipt bound to source, base, evaluated merge commit, and tree

realBackendPassed.observationAuthority: real Agentd probe plus retained chaos and authority evidence
realBackendPassed.acceptanceAuthority: validated hepta.ui-control.real-backend-receipt.v2 bound to the exact candidate and deployment digest

productionDeploymentApproved.observationAuthority: deployment-security, real-backend, independent accessibility, independent security, operational exercise, and production approval receipts
productionDeploymentApproved.acceptanceAuthority: non-expired production approval bound to all prerequisite evidence digests, five distinct review and approval principals, evidence-before-approval chronology, and an accepted external-evidence bundle
productionDeploymentApproved.passAuthority: deployment, release, and security authorities after trusted assurance-chain validation
